records.title: GLM-5V-Turbo: Toward a Native Foundation Model for Multimodal Agents
records.reason: This report describes GLM-5V-Turbo multimodal model design, training, and agent capability improvements; the abstract does not present an inference/serving efficiency contribution.

records.title: LangFlow: Continuous Diffusion Rivals Discrete in Language Modeling
records.reason: LangFlow studies continuous diffusion language-model quality/perplexity and comparisons with discrete models; its primary paper does not present inference-latency, throughput, memory, or serving-efficiency results.

records.title: Function Calling in Large Language Models: Industrial Practices, Challenges, and Future Directions
records.reason: The survey covers LLM function-calling concepts and evaluation, with computational efficiency as one metric among task challenges; it does not focus on methods for optimizing LLM inference or serving.

records.title: Designing synthetic regulatory elements using the generative AI framework DNA-Diffusion
records.reason: DNA-Diffusion is a synthetic regulatory-element generator evaluated in genomics; it is unrelated to language-model inference.

records.title: Next-Latent Prediction Transformers Learn Compact World Models
records.reason: NextLat studies latent-state/world-model learning objectives and representation compactness, not computationally efficient LLM inference or serving.
